beats.headline: THE LAST LETTER
beats.text: "Had I been an American, I would have been out of this jail in three days."

beats.headline: THE STAGE
beats.text: He was a college mimic in Rajasthan, playing an officer who would not talk under interrogation.

beats.headline: PROJECT X
beats.text: By 1975 he was across the border, in the office that mattered.

beats.headline: SIXTEEN YEARS
beats.text: Caught in 1983. Sentenced to death. Sixteen years in Pakistani jails.

beats.headline: THE BLACK TIGER
beats.text: RAW Files, Episode Three. Now on The Sisodia Files.
